item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Upper Tampa Bay Park: A nearly 600-acre hidden gem in Hillsborough County
item.description: Tucked away in Hillsborough County, Upper Tampa Bay Conservation Park is a nearly 600-acre natural escape offering everything from oak hammocks to salt barrens.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Drive a Corvette or Rolls-Royce on the water with Tampa Bay's Exotic Jetcars in a U.S. first
item.description: Vaughn Pitts and his partner launched Exotic Jetcars after spotting the watercraft in Dubai. They say it's the first business of its kind in the United States.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Town 'n' Country: Tampa's diverse, tight-knit community that prefers to fly under the radar
item.description: Town 'n' Country is an unincorporated area of Tampa that stretches from the airport west to the Upper Tampa Bay coastline and south to Rocky Point.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane, tropical storm] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tropical Storm Lala aims for Hawaii as two Atlantic systems push west
item.description: The National Hurricane Center is tracking two tropical systems in the Atlantic alongside Tropical Storm Lala in the Pacific, which is forecast to strengthen into a Category 1 hurricane before striking Hawaii.
